identification: Pro Hart, hand coloured line etching from the Littlewode Press 'Waltzing Matilda' series (Series 1), swagman by a gum tree watching a jumbuck at the billabong, 12.7 x 14.7 cm plate, framed. Comes with a Certificate of Authenticity from publisher Robert C. Littlewode (15 Dec 2011) stating it is an UNSIGNED Publisher's Proof from an edition of 100. The plate bears 'Pro Hart' in the plate (not a pencil signature).
